title: Forrestal's trips to Paris with questions

tellings.quote: I found several references to Portol for him going to Paris with questions and getting answers.

plain: In the 1940s, James Forrestal, a top US defence official who became the country's first Secretary of Defense, is said to have travelled to Paris with questions and come back with answers. A former presidential advisor named Harold Malmgren says he found "several references" to these trips in records. He does not say what the questions were, but in this telling they hint at early secret contacts over the UFO subject.
